description: Inline #tags. A tag is # at the start of a paragraph, a line, or emphasis content, or after Unicode whitespace (U+00A0 and U+3000 included), then tag characters, with at least one that isn't a digit or /. A # right after other markup (a link, code, an entity) starts no tag. Trailing /s stay out of the tag. Any other character ends it.
requiresOneOf: a character that isn't a digit or /
afterEmphasisRun: a tag after a run of * or _ stands only when the run opens emphasis
